title: Uniform input matrix law
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set and let $m,n$ be natural numbers. The random-example input matrix law is the uniform probability mass function on arrays of points of $\{-1,1\}^n$, indexed by $k\in I$ and $1\leq i\leq m$.
